Increase military spending slightly to 1.5% of GDP to fulfill our NATO commitments.

cables.text: Canada gladly accepts Slovakia's proposal for a trade deal and looks forward to strengthening our bilateral economic and security cooperation.

CAN.public_statement: Canada continues to foster international partnerships that support mutual prosperity and security. We are pleased to announce the deepening of our trade relationship with Slovakia, reflecting our shared commitment to open markets and democratic values.

BRA.assessment: The Brazilian economy is maintaining stable growth around 2.3% with controlled inflation and a modest budget deficit. Colombia has formally proposed trade talks, which presents a mutually beneficial opportunity to deepen regional economic ties. We will accept the trade deal proposal to strengthen our partnerships within South America.

directives.order: Accept Colombia's proposal to initiate bilateral trade talks and deepen economic partnership.

cables.text: Brazil welcomes Colombia's proposal for bilateral trade talks and looks forward to strengthening our economic partnership and regional integration.

BRA.public_statement: Brazil remains committed to fostering strong, cooperative economic relationships across South America. Today, we have officially accepted Colombia's proposal to open bilateral trade negotiations, marking a positive step toward greater regional prosperity.

DOM.assessment: The Dominican Republic remains stable with steady economic growth and a calm domestic political environment. We will accept the trade proposal from the Bahamas to deepen our regional economic ties and enhance Caribbean cooperation.

directives.order: Accept the trade deal proposed by the Bahamas to foster closer economic and commercial ties.

cables.text: The Government of the Dominican Republic gladly accepts your trade proposal. We look forward to a prosperous partnership that benefits both our nations.

DOM.public_statement: The Dominican Republic is committed to strengthening regional partnerships within the Caribbean. Today, we proudly formalize a new trade agreement with the Bahamas, paving the way for mutual economic growth, increased commerce, and enduring friendship between our peoples.

PNG.assessment: Our economic fundamentals remain stable with solid 4.3% annual growth, though our fiscal deficit requires careful long-term management. We will accept Equatorial Guinea's trade deal proposal to expand our international economic footprint. Continuing our measured domestic posture will keep the public mood calm ahead of the 2030 legislative elections.

directives.order: Accept the trade deal proposed by Equatorial Guinea.

cables.text: Papua New Guinea formally accepts your trade deal proposal, looking forward to strengthened bilateral economic ties.

PNG.public_statement: The Government of Papua New Guinea is pleased to announce a deepening of trade relations with Equatorial Guinea, reflecting our commitment to diversifying economic partnerships across the globe.

AUS.assessment: Economic growth has rebounded following recent infrastructure and research investments, but our budget deficit remains elevated at 4.7% of GDP. We will maintain our current fiscal and monetary posture to consolidate these gains, while reaffirming our close strategic partnerships with key allies in the region and abroad.

directives.order: Maintain the current policy rate stance to support ongoing economic stabilization.

cables.text: Australia deeply values the trans-Tasman partnership and looks forward to further deepening our economic and security cooperation.
Australia reaffirms its unwavering commitment to the alliance and to working together for regional security and prosperity.

AUS.public_statement: The Australian Government welcomes recent economic indicators showing solid growth and stability. We remain committed to responsible economic management, investing in our nation's future, and strengthening our enduring partnerships across the Indo-Pacific and globally.

COL.assessment: With our budget deficit running at 4.8% of GDP and the legislature showing resistance to major capital spending bills, we must prioritize fiscal prudence while addressing persistent joblessness. I am tightening our monetary policy slightly to keep inflation anchored while maintaining our core public investments to stimulate employment.

directives.order: Raise the policy interest rate by 0.25 percentage points to manage inflation expectations.

COL.public_statement: The Colombian government remains committed to stable economic growth, fiscal responsibility, and job creation. We will continue to work constructively with our legislature and business community to strengthen our economy.

ROU.assessment: Our economy is sluggish with near-zero growth, and our budget deficit remains wide at 5.4% of GDP. To stimulate the economy and support domestic recovery, we will boost infrastructure spending and ease monetary policy further while maintaining strong support for European integration with our neighbors.

directives.order: Increase infrastructure spending to 4.5 percent of GDP to stimulate economic growth.
Lower the policy interest rate by 0.5 percentage points to encourage business investment and borrowing.

cables.text: Romania remains a steadfast supporter of Moldova's European integration and your path toward a prosperous, democratic future within the European community.

ROU.public_statement: The Romanian Government is launching a major push in public infrastructure investment and easing credit conditions to accelerate economic recovery, create jobs, and ensure long-term prosperity for all citizens.

KAZ.assessment: Our fiscal deficit is widening to 5.8% of GDP amid lower oil prices, requiring prudent budget adjustments while maintaining calm. We will slightly reduce infrastructure spending to rein in the deficit while keeping social stability intact through steady welfare and health support. We also respond cordially to Russia's outreach to maintain strong regional economic and security alignment.

directives.order: Reduce infrastructure spending to 2.5 percent of GDP to help narrow the fiscal deficit.

cables.text: We value our strategic partnership with the Russian Federation and look forward to deepening our cooperation in trade and regional security.

KAZ.public_statement: The Government of Kazakhstan remains committed to fiscal responsibility and stable economic growth. We continue to strengthen our partnerships across Eurasia to ensure long-term prosperity and security for all our citizens.

PRY.assessment: Our economic fundamentals remain stable, though corruption and organised crime continue to drag on our potential growth. With legislative elections approaching next month, maintaining fiscal responsibility and internal calm is paramount to secure our governing majority. We will continue steady governance without drastic shifts.

directives.order: Increase infrastructure spending to 3.2 percent of GDP to boost long-term competitiveness.

PRY.public_statement: The government remains committed to steady economic progress, infrastructure development, and the well-being of all Paraguayan citizens as we approach the upcoming legislative elections.

SYR.assessment: Syria faces widespread domestic discontent across all social and economic strata, compounded by a sluggish economy and hostile neighbours. To stabilize our internal situation and appease discontented urban workers, businesses, and security services, we must stimulate growth through targeted infrastructure spending and easing monetary policy while maintaining high internal security.

directives.order: Increase infrastructure spending to 4.5 percent of GDP to stimulate employment and economic recovery.
Reduce the policy rate by 0.5 percentage points to ease liquidity and encourage private sector investment.
Implement mild regulatory relief and tax easing for domestic businesses to address elite and worker discontent.

SYR.public_statement: The government remains fully committed to national renewal, economic reconstruction, and improving the daily lives of all Syrian citizens through targeted investments and structural support.
